d52c3620-91b7-49c6-9d23-a50a87abfb45/pipeline.py · 第4—13行def process_records(records):
    """按类目汇总金额，返回 {类目: 合计}。

    具名实现：process_records —— 与补证任务交付物同名。
    """
    totals = {}
    for record in records:
        key = record.get("category", "未分类")
        totals[key] = totals.get(key, 0) + float(record.get("amount", 0))
    return totals

d52c3620-91b7-49c6-9d23-a50a87abfb45/tests/test_pipeline.py · 第5—13行def test_process_records_totals():
    records = [
        {"category": "图书", "amount": "12.5"},
        {"category": "图书", "amount": "30"},
        {"category": "文具", "amount": "8"},
    ]
    result = process_records(records)
    assert result["图书"] == 42.5
    assert result["文具"] == 8
